title.sl: Več trpnika: has been repaired, it is said
title.de: Mehr Passiv: has been repaired, it is said
title.it: Ancora il passivo: has been repaired, it is said
title.en: More of the passive: has been repaired, it is said

rule.sl:
Trpnik je v vsakem času **be** + deležnik: spremeni se le be, deležnik ostane.

Že narejeno: **The roof has been mended.** Se dela zdaj: **The road is being repaired.** **The bridge was being mended when the flood came.** Prej: **The hay had been cut before the rain came.** Prihodnost in modalni: **It will be finished by Friday.** **It's going to be sold.** **It should be mended soon.**

Za preteklost z modalnim: **have been** + deležnik: **The gate should have been shut.** **My hat must have been taken.**

Ljudje rečejo tudi *It's been broke*; pisno je **broken**. V govoru je pravilno tudi **got**: **It got mended.**

Kar ljudje pravijo: **It is said that**, **It is thought that**, **It is believed that**, **It is known that**: **It is said that the tarn has no bottom.** (Pravijo, da jezerce nima dna.) Slovenščina reče *pravijo, da*; v govoru **People say that**.

Osebek lahko gre naprej, potem **to** + osnovna oblika: **Old Wilf is said to be ninety.** **Wastwater is known to be very deep.** Za preteklost **to have** + deležnik: **The bridge is said to have been built by the Romans.** **Wilf is said to have seen a ghost.**
rule.de:
Das Passiv ist in jeder Zeit **be** + Partizip: Nur be ändert sich, das Partizip bleibt.

Schon gemacht: **The roof has been mended.** Geschieht gerade: **The road is being repaired.** **The bridge was being mended when the flood came.** Davor: **The hay had been cut before the rain came.** Zukunft und Modalverben: **It will be finished by Friday.** **It's going to be sold.** **It should be mended soon.** *wird repariert* = **is repaired**, *ist repariert worden* = **has been repaired**.

Für die Vergangenheit mit Modalverb: **have been** + Partizip: **The gate should have been shut.** **My hat must have been taken.**

Man sagt auch *It's been broke*; geschrieben steht **broken**. Gesprochen ist auch **got** richtig: **It got mended.**

Was man sagt: **It is said that**, **It is thought that**, **It is believed that**, **It is known that**: **It is said that the tarn has no bottom.** Gesprochen **People say that**.

Das Subjekt kann nach vorn, dann **to** + Grundform: **Old Wilf is said to be ninety.** (Der alte Wilf soll neunzig sein.) **Wastwater is known to be very deep.** Für die Vergangenheit **to have** + Partizip: **The bridge is said to have been built by the Romans.**
rule.it:
Il passivo è in ogni tempo **be** + participio: cambia solo be, il participio resta.

Già fatto: **The roof has been mended.** Si sta facendo: **The road is being repaired.** **The bridge was being mended when the flood came.** Prima: **The hay had been cut before the rain came.** Futuro e modali: **It will be finished by Friday.** **It's going to be sold.** **It should be mended soon.**

Per il passato con un modale: **have been** + participio: **The gate should have been shut.** **My hat must have been taken.**

Si dice anche *It's been broke*; per iscritto si usa **broken**. A voce va bene anche **got**: **It got mended.**

Quello che si dice: **It is said that**, **It is thought that**, **It is believed that**, **It is known that**: **It is said that the tarn has no bottom.** (Si dice che il laghetto non abbia fondo.) A voce **People say that**.

Il soggetto può andare davanti, poi **to** + forma base: **Old Wilf is said to be ninety.** **Wastwater is known to be very deep.** Per il passato **to have** + participio: **The bridge is said to have been built by the Romans.** **Wilf is said to have seen a ghost.**
rule.en:
The passive in every tense is **be** + the participle: only be changes, the participle stays.

Already done: **The roof has been mended.** Going on now: **The road is being repaired.** **The bridge was being mended when the flood came.** Before that: **The hay had been cut before the rain came.** The future and modals: **It will be finished by Friday.** **It's going to be sold.** **It should be mended soon.**

The past with a modal: **have been** + the participle: **The gate should have been shut.** **My hat must have been taken.**

People also say *It's been broke*; writing wants **broken**. In talk **got** is right too: **It got mended.**

What people say: **It is said that**, **It is thought that**, **It is believed that**, **It is known that**: **It is said that the tarn has no bottom.** In talk **People say that**.

The subject can go first, then **to** + the base form: **Old Wilf is said to be ninety.** **Wastwater is known to be very deep.** For the past **to have** + the participle: **The bridge is said to have been built by the Romans.** **Wilf is said to have seen a ghost.**
